contract.duty: Handler publishes native reason or transfers failure custody before last old-route access; count zero is not work closure
Permanent trampoline uses one tagged lock-free admission/refcount CAS before dereferencing route or endpoint; paused pre-CAS handler is uncounted but harmless
Close same atomic admission gate first; late handlers cannot acquire old generation; do not confuse disposition update with grace completion
Retire old route/native endpoint only after admission closed, active pins zero, work/fault debt zero and old-roster receipt; stable shell outlives VM
Track actual calling-thread mask and normalized results; thread roster/birth fence needed for any all-thread claim; masking is not route reclamation authority
Unknown mask/disposition/wake result retains coordinator and delivery custody; no false drain acknowledgement or blocking of GC roles
Drain while old roster/root/finite-wait services remain alive; caller POSIX mask is distinct from Scheme sync-op service mask
Denied or ambiguous late signal goes to process-lifetime native mailbox, not stale VM pointer or automatic next-generation replay; preserve reason policy

gain.avoided: Old route reclamation need not wait for unrelated threads to mask under the qualified atomic gate
gain.added: Permanent shell plus tagged gate and active pins
gain.condition: A selected pre-CAS handler may be denied after route retirement; every legacy bypass must first migrate

gain.avoided: Owner can continue old-roster GC while coordinator awaits handler/work closure
gain.added: Nonblocking retirement state machine, native reason mailbox and finite-wait fallback
gain.condition: Progress requires handler termination, scheduler/OS fairness and prior wake protocol; no measured speedup

gain.avoided: Avoid fd/route ABA and silent late-signal reassignment
gain.added: Generation overflow policy, reason custody and typed failures
gain.condition: O(R+H+T) route/active-handler/thread-policy metadata; process shell cannot be reclaimed by individual VM

gain.avoided: Modern C preserves Scheme semantics and C portability with generated typed adapters
gain.added: C atomics, stable shell, semantic reason dispatch and source proof
gain.condition: Zig cannot remove signal ABI, root lifetime, grace or semantic ownership proofs; no mandatory incremental benefit established

gate.duty: Tagged gate representable and always lock-free on admitted ABI; overflow, nested handler and SC/source proof
Trampoline code, gate and mailbox outlive all handler selections; VM cleanup/dlclose cannot reclaim them
Late pending reason identity and destination policy resolved; no automatic old-to-new replay or silent drop
HB/TTY/SIGCHLD/crash and external disposition owners audited; no legacy handler bypass
All-thread mask claims use complete thread birth/join roster and known per-thread results; pending signal policy explicit
Root adapters, finite native wake fallback and selected sync-op/resize/NOOP integration qualified
No unknown notification/close/route custody; dependency grace and inherited host attestation remain unqualified

0.reason: Revoke shares same entry/count atomic gate

2.reason: Handler exit is not work drain

4.reason: Old roster remains until drain receipt

6.reason: Mask failure is not an acknowledgement

7.reason: Selected work snapshots preserve late work

8.reason: Stable mailbox preserves semantic reason custody

9.reason: Old route retirement cannot free process mailbox
